summary: The Liner Startup Grant Program advertises up to $1,000 in credits with no equity taken and nothing to repay. Its blog describes broader Liner API coverage including Search API and Search Agent API, but the current linked application calls the grant Search Agent API credits; confirm the approved product scope before budgeting. The form requires company email, company name, company website and product interest. Liner reviews applications by email, with a confirmation message saying next steps include a link to book a 20-minute onboarding call. No grant-spend expiry is stated publicly.
claim_steps: Open the application linked from build.liner.com/blog/liner-startup-grant-program (about two minutes).
Submit company email (company domain, not personal), company name, company website, and which Liner product you will build on.

Watch email for the review outcome and next steps, including a link to book a 20-minute onboarding call. Confirm which API products the approved credits cover; the form names Search Agent API while the blog describes broader API coverage.

social_proof.title: Liner Startup Grant Program: $1,000 in API Credits
social_proof.text: The Liner Startup Grant Program gives eligible startups up to $1,000 in Liner API credits. The grant is up to $1,000 in credits across the Liner API, including the Liner Search API and the Search Agent API. You keep 100 percent of your equity, and there is nothing to pay back.

social_proof.title: Pricing | Liner Developers
social_proof.text: Credits are a prepaid balance used to pay for API use. Search Agent is $20 per 1,000 requests; Quick Answer Agent is $3 per 1,000 requests; Deep Research Agent is $200 per 1,000 requests.

social_proof.title: Official offer conditions and claim requirements
social_proof.text: Eligible startups can receive up to $1,000 in Liner Search Agent API credits. ... We’ll review your application and email you with next steps, including a link to book a 20-minute onboarding call.
